card.title: Blast radius

card.snapshotFootnoteNoSha: Based on the default-branch index; code added in this PR is not included.
card.mayDependHint: Endpoints and crons come from the files that call this symbol, so they are possible dependents, not confirmed ones.
card.wholeFileHint: Whole file: no diff available, every symbol in this file is shown.

error.title: Could not load the blast radius
error.body: The impact map could not be read. Try again.

disabled.title: Repo analysis is turned off
disabled.body: Repo Intel is disabled, so the impact of this PR cannot be mapped.

notIndexed.title: This repo is not indexed yet
notIndexed.body: Index the repo to see which callers, endpoints and crons this PR can affect.

indexing.title: Indexing in progress
indexing.body: The repo is being indexed. This card updates on its own when it finishes.

reindexing.title: Re-indexing
reindexing.body: The repo is being re-indexed; the data below may change shortly.

degraded.title: The index is unavailable
degraded.body: The last index run did not produce usable data, so the impact cannot be mapped. Re-analyze to try again.

partial.title: Partial index
partial.body: Some files were not indexed. The results below may be missing callers.

factsIncomplete.title: Index incomplete
factsIncomplete.body: Endpoint and cron data was not fully indexed, so these results may miss dependents.

noChangedFiles.title: No changed files found
noChangedFiles.body: DevDigest has no file list for this PR yet. Open the Diff tab once, then come back.

noSymbols.title: No indexed symbols in the changed files
noSymbols.body: The changed files contain no indexed symbols. Only TypeScript and JavaScript are indexed, so this is not proof of no impact.

noSymbolTouched.title: The diff touches no declared symbol
noSymbolTouched.body: {count, plural, one {The diff only touches imports or top-level code in # file.} other {The diff only touches imports or top-level code in # files.}}

zeroCallers.title: No callers found
zeroCallers.body: Nothing in the index calls the changed symbols.

zeroCallersIncomplete.title: Callers unknown
zeroCallersIncomplete.body: No callers were found, but the index is incomplete, so this is not proof that nothing is affected.

uncovered.title: Not covered by the index
uncovered.body: {count, plural, one {# changed file is} other {# changed files are}} not in the index (new, or an unsupported language).

noDownstream: {count} changed symbol(s), no downstream callers found.
